name: US-align
summary: Structure alignment for proteins, nucleic acids and multichain complexes.

steps: Read the maintainer's README and LICENSE. Choose the documented source-build, Bioconda or Homebrew route for the user's OS and CPU; current Bioconda instructions cover Linux/macOS, not native Windows.

If compiling, obtain a reviewed source revision and use the documented compiler for Linux/macOS or MinGW-w64/WSL2 for Windows. Review source and output paths before building; this catalog does not run make or a downloaded script.
Keep the program in a user-chosen directory, run USalign -h, then compare the maintainer's small example structures. Do not upload confidential structures to an online service.
install.verify_note: Run USalign -h and a maintainer example pair in the selected local environment. A help message alone does not validate alignment output.

notes: US-align includes protein and nucleic-acid monomer/complex comparison. It is a structure-alignment tool, not a structure predictor or docking search engine. Package-manager builds may lag the maintainer source. No source revision or binary digest has been approved for automatic execution.
